$comment: Committed settings: every worktree and every session starts here.
Machine-specific things (paths to Daz, Qt, Unity) belong in settings.local.json,
includeCoAuthoredBy is false because this repository's commits are written as
the project's own voice. History before DVB-29 carries a Co-Authored-By trailer;
The deny list is the vendored-code boundary made mechanical rather than left to
prose: the Unity template's samples and the embedded XR package are not ours to
edit, and they are nearly 600 of the 807 tracked files, so an edit landing there
is far more likely to be a mistake than an intention.
